global_contract: PPIA-15 creates regression reference contracts, not new application commands or mutation authority.

Any action capable of causing authoritative mutation is only a presentation of an existing owning-domain command and retains that domain's authorization, expected_version, operation_id, idempotency and recovery rules.
Permission/entitlement filtering precedes action availability and action labels where protected existence is involved.
status-unknown never becomes permission to retry blindly.
Offline/local state never fabricates an authoritative Event.
P15-ACT-020 preserves P15-GAP-001/F024 as unsupported rather than supplying lifecycle semantics.
